bug_description: MCP debug workflow test - verify centralized sessions work after fix

hypotheses.bug_observation: The MCP session storage was fragmented - NewSessionManager stored sessions relative to workDir instead of always using workspace root
hypotheses.root_cause_theory: NewSessionManager uses the workDir parameter directly without detecting the workspace root. When MCP server runs from different directories (workspace root vs devtools-mcp/), sessions get stored in different .devtools-mcp/sessions/ directories.
hypotheses.evidence_chain: 1. MCP configured to run from devtools-mcp/ folder → 2. NewSessionManager uses workDir (devtools-mcp/) → 3. Sessions stored in devtools-mcp/.devtools-mcp/sessions/ → 4. Sessions also exist in workspace_root/.devtools-mcp/sessions/ from other runs → 5. Sessions fragmented across two locations
hypotheses.falsification_test: If we add workspace root detection (look for .git or .vscode/) and always use that for session storage, sessions should all go to one location regardless of MCP working directory.
hypotheses.hypothesis_text: The bug is caused by devtools-mcp/manager.go - NewSessionManager function: NewSessionManager uses the workDir parameter directly without detecting the workspace root. When MCP server runs from different directories (workspace root vs devtools-mcp/), sessions get stored in different .devtools-mcp/sessions/ directories.. This produces the symptom (The MCP session storage was fragmented - NewSessionManager stored sessions relative to workDir instead of always using workspace root) through this mechanism: 1. MCP configured to run from devtools-mcp/ folder → 2. NewSessionManager uses workDir (devtools-mcp/) → 3. Sessions stored in devtools-mcp/.devtools-mcp/sessions/ → 4. Sessions also exist in workspace_root/.devtools-mcp/sessions/ from other runs → 5. Sessions fragmented across two locations

fix_description: Added findWorkspaceRoot() function to detect workspace root by looking for .git or .vscode/ directories. Modified NewSessionManager to call findWorkspaceRoot(workDir) and always use workspace root for session storage. This ensures all sessions go to workspace_root/.devtools-mcp/sessions/ regardless of where MCP server is running.
